home.heroTitle: Learn what matters, at your own pace.
home.heroSubtitle: Free courses taught by experts from Azerbaijan Technical University — online or in person. Enroll, learn and follow your progress in one place.
home.categoriesDesc: Choose the field that interests you and see the courses in it.
home.featuredDesc: The courses our experts published most recently.
home.howItWorksTitle: From sign-up to your first lesson in three steps
home.step1Desc: Browse the catalog by category, mode (online or offline), rating and duration.
home.step2Desc: Every course is free for now, so enrollment starts instantly. Offline cohorts are confirmed by the expert.
home.step3Desc: Your progress saves automatically — pick up where you left off on any device.
home.whyUsTitle: Built for the way you actually learn
home.whyUsDesc: Take lessons online at your own pace or learn with a group in a classroom — either way, the course is taught by experts.
home.feature1Desc: Watch online lessons whenever you like, on whichever device you like.
home.feature2Desc: Join live classes in a classroom, with limited seats, a real schedule and dedicated rooms.
home.feature3Desc: Lessons you finish are recorded automatically, and your dashboard shows how far along you are in every course.
home.tutorsTitle: Learn from people who do the work
home.tutorsDesc: Specialists from the Azerbaijan Technical University faculty and industry.
home.testimonial1Text: The mix of online videos and weekend offline classes was perfect for my schedule.
home.testimonial2Text: Experts actually reply to questions. That changes everything when you're stuck.
home.testimonial3Text: I finished my first course in two weeks. The progress tracker kept me honest.
home.faqDesc: Can't find the answer you need? Write to the AzTU team and we'll get back to you.
home.faq1Q: How are AzTU EduPlatform courses different from regular videos?
home.faq1A: Every course is organised into modules and lessons and tracks your progress automatically. Offline courses also include schedules and assigned rooms.
home.faq2Q: Do I need to pay to start?
home.faq2A: No — every course in the catalog is free right now. Offline cohorts may require approval from the expert before your seat is confirmed.
home.faq3Q: Can I switch between online and offline?
home.faq3A: Each course is set up either as online or offline by the expert. You can enroll in any number of either kind at the same time.
home.faq4Q: Will my progress be saved if I switch devices?
home.faq4A: Yes — progress is saved on the server. Sign in on another device and pick up exactly where you left off.
home.faq5Q: Is the platform available in Azerbaijani?
home.faq5A: Yes. Switch between English and Azərbaycan from the language selector in the top-right corner.
home.ctaTitle: Start learning with AzTU EduPlatform today
home.ctaDesc: Create a free account and enroll in your first course in minutes.

landing.faqSub: Didn't find your answer? Write to us and the AzTU team will reply.
landing.faq1A: Yes. Every course in the catalogue is currently free. Create an account and join any course you like.
landing.faq2Q: How do online and in-person courses differ?
landing.faq2A: Online courses are made of video lessons you take at your own pace. In-person courses run in a classroom on set dates with limited seats; dates, weekly hours and the address are on the course page.
landing.faq3Q: Will my progress be kept if I switch devices?
landing.faq3A: Yes. Progress is stored on the server: sign in on another device and carry on where you left off.
landing.faq4Q: How can I teach a course as an expert?
landing.faq4A: Fill in the expert application. An administrator reviews it; once approved you can create courses in the expert portal.
landing.faq5Q: Which languages is the platform in?
landing.faq5A: The site is in Azerbaijani and English. Each course's teaching language is shown on its page.
